headline: Prabowo Discusses BTS Jakarta Concert With South Korean President
seoTitle: Jakarta Prepares For BTS and Guns N' Roses Concerts
metaDescription: President Prabowo Subianto thanked South Korean President Lee Jae Myung regarding the upcoming BTS concert in Jakarta during the ASEAN Summit.
aiSummaryBullets: President Prabowo Subianto met with South Korean President Lee Jae Myung at the ASEAN Summit to discuss the upcoming BTS concert in Jakarta.
The third day of the BTS performance in Indonesia will be broadcast live across 2,800 cinema screens in more than 80 countries.
Jakarta officials expect both the BTS and Guns N' Roses concerts to generate significant economic and tourism impacts for the capital city.
aiContextParagraph: The capital city of Jakarta is preparing to host major international performances by BTS and Guns N' Roses in December 2026. These events are projected by local officials to boost the regional economy and tourism sector. To support the influx of attendees, authorities have announced plans to extend the operational hours of public transportation, including the MRT, LRT, and TransJakarta. The cultural significance of the BTS visit has reached the diplomatic level, with President Prabowo Subianto expressing appreciation to South Korean President Lee Jae Myung during their meeting at the ASEAN Summit. Furthermore, the final day of the BTS concert series is set for a global reach, with plans to broadcast the performance live to thousands of cinema screens worldwide. Meanwhile, the Guns N' Roses concert will feature a lineup of notable guitarists, including local performers.
whyItIsViral: The event is gaining strong traction following widespread media coverage across eight outlets and high-level diplomatic discussions between the Indonesian and South Korean heads of state.
